title: Titanium Cassette Cog
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Grade 5, UNS R56400) was selected for this drivetrain hardware application because its 900+ MPa tensile enables thin-wall lightweighting under cyclic loading. The alpha-beta microstructure provides 45% higher specific strength than 4140 steel, critical for weight-sensitive designs. Its 6.7 W/mK thermal conductivity simplifies thermal management. This rationale is driven by lightweight cassette sprocket cog and service environment demands.
process: CNC turning Swiss-type for drivetrain hardware geometry
Thread rolling DIN 13-1 6g at 200W fiber laser
Go/No-Go ring gauging at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: Bead blasting 120 grit Al2O3 for matte finish Ra 1.6-3.2um followed by passive oxide stabilization in DI water — tailored for lightweight cassette sprocket application
commonFailures: Bearing race brinelling from over-torque - avoided by torque-limiting press-fit tool with ±2% accuracy — critical for lightweight cassette sprocket performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Cassette Cog suitable for Lightweight cassette sprocket cog?
faq.a: Titanium Cassette Cog uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address drivetrain hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Cassette Cog?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Cassette Cog is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for lightweight cassette sprocket requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Cassette Cog require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. lightweight cassette sprocket components require Bead blasting 120 grit Al2O3 for matte finish Ra 1.6-3.2um followed by passive oxide stabilization in DI water — tailored for lightweight cassette sprocket application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Cassette Cog shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Cassette Cog includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet lightweight cassette sprocket specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
